scope: Planning only: no domain ticket is implemented by this file.

tasks.title: Shared contracts, errors, runtime validation and transaction interfaces
tasks.acceptance: Contracts compile; fixtures show success, field errors and invalid states; no business route claims before implementation.

tasks.title: Schema/FKs/constraints review and migration queue
tasks.acceptance: Reviewed schema matches approved contracts; replay on clean PG; partial indexes and CHECKs survive migration workflow.

tasks.title: Idempotent job creation helper
tasks.acceptance: Order confirmation can create exactly one scheduled job using caller transaction.

tasks.title: Shared shell/login and six page patterns
tasks.acceptance: One list/detail/form/timeline/action/summary pattern; consistent keyboard, loading, empty and failure states.

tasks.title: Staff sessions, roles and authorization
tasks.acceptance: Real login/logout, password hashing, CSRF and record/file authorization; no role-picker bypass.

tasks.title: Public enquiry, CRM, qualification and follow-up
tasks.acceptance: Invalid contacts fail gracefully; valid public submission persists and is visible after refresh; phone/WhatsApp source recorded manually.

tasks.title: Survey scheduling, submission and approval
tasks.acceptance: Required roof measurements, assigned technician and immutable approved revision; rejected/unapproved survey cannot quote.

tasks.title: Catalogue and versioned 1–5 kW package/BOM fixtures
tasks.acceptance: All required parts present; on/off-grid distinct; controller follows fictional PDF catalogue; current templates do not rewrite history.

tasks.title: Quote snapshot and complete component requirements
tasks.acceptance: Approved survey FK, package/component/service line types; package and BOM not charged twice; accepted version immutable.

tasks.title: Single finance writer: invoices, payments and costs
tasks.acceptance: Unique posting source/idempotency; partial receipts reconcile; money and signed reversals explicit; payment recording not gateway processing.

tasks.title: Acceptance/order confirmation and fulfillment handoff
tasks.acceptance: One transaction creates order/job/invoice/packing obligations once; payment is separate and gates work.

tasks.title: Private evidence upload/download
tasks.acceptance: Completed file metadata, size/type checks and authorized access; failed upload never satisfies completion evidence.

tasks.title: Subsidy milestones and next responsible party
tasks.acceptance: Stage/owner/dates/evidence queryable; no live portal or guaranteed subsidy claim.

tasks.title: Sales/finance/security tests and E2E harness
tasks.acceptance: Server invalid-state, receipt retry, role/file tests; harness uses real API and PostgreSQL.

tasks.title: Clean release startup, setup and submission checklist
tasks.acceptance: Native/Compose mode conflict documented; actual event fields checked; local release/recovery steps reproducible.

tasks.title: Sales/finance frontend integration and reconciliation
tasks.acceptance: D1 integration slot resolves contract mismatches; real writes refresh; report definitions and invoice/payment/cost source ownership agreed.

tasks.title: Scan/photo/signature capability spike and phone topology
tasks.acceptance: H3 actual available hardware tested; source method preserved; permission/error states visible; rerun against real endpoints by H12.

tasks.title: Public enquiry, qualification and survey UI
tasks.acceptance: Typed fixture contract first, then persisted API; survey gate and field errors visible; no static acceptance data.

tasks.title: Order workspace, quote/BOM, invoice and receipt UI
tasks.acceptance: Current status/next action visible; finance totals from API; idempotent submit/retry behavior.

tasks.title: Actual-cost stock receipts and derived on-hand
tasks.acceptance: Receipt reference/quantity/cost stored; bulk weighted average and serialized acquisition costs are real inputs, not hardcoded margins.

tasks.title: Unit serial identity and active assignment constraints
tasks.acceptance: Normalized scoped serial uniqueness; unit UUID; active allocation persists through installed state.

tasks.title: Atomic allocation of complete order requirements
tasks.acceptance: Stable sorted locks, sufficient quantities, exact source requirements; all-or-none reservation and no double booking.

tasks.title: Scanning, dispatch and consumed cost posting
tasks.acceptance: All serialized panels/inverter/controller/battery required by package have scan events before dispatch; distinguish CAMERA/SCANNER/TYPED; reject invalid units; post movement/cost once.

tasks.title: Delivery and equipment-specific coverage activation
tasks.acceptance: Delivery starts each unit warranty once; customer/unit lookup returns traceable dates; no extension on retry.

tasks.title: Replacement and return stock primitives
tasks.acceptance: Ticket source allocation; old unit quarantined and linked to new; coverage continuation explicit; use caller tx.

tasks.title: Real PostgreSQL concurrency, rollback and retry tests
tasks.acceptance: Two connections contend for same unit; one winner; balance/movement/cost counts correct; delivery retry and replacement preserve history.

tasks.title: Catalogue/stock/history seed helpers
tasks.acceptance: Explicit disposable demo DB, fixture IDs and historical dates; same invariants as production; no normal-startup reset.

tasks.title: Fulfillment UI integration and scan rehearsal
tasks.acceptance: Real device/scanner scan persists; every required unit accounted for; D1 integration slot and runtime serial timeline work.

tasks.title: ERD, migration replay and DB/files restore evidence
tasks.acceptance: Clean migration replay and second-host matching DB/files backup; no real customer data or credentials committed.

tasks.title: Warehouse allocation, scan and delivery UI
tasks.acceptance: Use I06/I07 APIs at integration; scan source/missing units clear; no local stock mutation.

tasks.title: Crew schedule and assigned-job permissions
tasks.acceptance: Assigned jobs visible without phone handoff; unauthorized technician cannot access another job.

tasks.title: Field completion with time, size and acceptance evidence
tasks.acceptance: Reject missing photo/signature/time/kW, future/invalid times and completion before delivery; uploaded evidence belongs to job.

tasks.title: Time entries and cost/pay rate snapshots
tasks.acceptance: Valid chronological hours times recorded rates; cost posted once; staff entry actor distinguished from technician who performed work.

tasks.title: Explained warranty/service coverage decision
tasks.acceptance: Stored unit/policy/as-of/scope/reason; covered/expired/boundary examples; no automatic supplier reimbursement.

tasks.title: Ticket lifecycle and customer-confirmed closure
tasks.acceptance: Resolve differs from close; confirmer/channel/time required; historical policy snapshot not rewritten by later changes.

tasks.title: Repair costs and chargeable invoice orchestration
tasks.acceptance: Covered customer charge zero but actual parts/time cost; expired/no-service case invoice once; no receipt implied by invoice.

tasks.title: Replacement orchestration and lineage
tasks.acceptance: Same transaction invokes stock/finance helpers; old/new serials traceable; customer charge follows assessed policy.

tasks.title: Operational and financial report queries
tasks.acceptance: Period invoice/cash/cost activity separate from lifetime job contribution; incomplete jobs not completed profit; IST half-open ranges.

tasks.title: Technician pay summary and filtered CSV
tasks.acceptance: Approved hours times rates reconcile; filtered CSV matches source and scope, quotes text safely and prevents spreadsheet formula injection without corrupting numeric losses.

tasks.title: Field/service/date/reconciliation acceptance tests
tasks.acceptance: Evidence/auth gates; coverage dates including leap day; midnight/month rollover; actual query values match oracle.

tasks.title: Historical demo fixtures, speakers and rehearsal script
tasks.acceptance: Run-prefixed valid historical records; fully paid 1 kW replacement loss plus expired 3 kW charge; portfolio/period/pay/CSV oracle; no global clock change.

tasks.title: Field/service/report integration slot
tasks.acceptance: D1 consumes real endpoints; confirmation and report updates persist; no mocked success.

tasks.title: Field completion and service decision UI
tasks.acceptance: Phone form, ticket explanation, acceptance/confirmation states; use backend response, not duplicate eligibility formulas.

tasks.title: Director report, pay/subsidy summaries and CSV UI
tasks.acceptance: Explicit scope/period labels, real API values, no static KPIs; required summaries accessible.

tasks.title: Sales/finance integration slot
tasks.acceptance: Six coherent workspaces; one order/customer timeline; no unresolved critical errors, stale data or keyboard/mobile blockers.

tasks.title: Stock/fulfillment integration slot
tasks.acceptance: Six coherent workspaces; one order/customer timeline; no unresolved critical errors, stale data or keyboard/mobile blockers.

tasks.title: Field/service/report integration slot
tasks.acceptance: Six coherent workspaces; one order/customer timeline; no unresolved critical errors, stale data or keyboard/mobile blockers.

tasks.title: Responsive/accessibility final pass
tasks.acceptance: Six coherent workspaces; one order/customer timeline; no unresolved critical errors, stale data or keyboard/mobile blockers.

tasks.title: Three timed demonstrations and UI fixes
tasks.acceptance: Actual action count and three run times recorded; <=180-second short presentation or explicitly shorter honest script; full evaluator path remains.

dependencyMeaning: Required coding inputs: agreed contracts and valid DB fixture factories allow parallel implementation. Acceptance of helpers with fixture inputs is not end-to-end done; B12/I11/S13 and F09 join real modules. No runtime validation bypass is permitted.

gates.meaning: Contracts/schema and hardware choice, not completed domain software
Intake and capability spike; field/upload endpoint proof follows later
Quote/finance/core allocation code ready on valid fixtures
Feature freeze and domain test/recovery evidence
All UI/domain joins and full evaluator path
